title: [M1] Versioned actor, target and runtime-profile contracts
description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M1
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M1-01
**Implementation status:** Implemented; self-tests PASS; independent QA pending.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex CLI (/root). Required skill: Authorized engineer for this bounded deliverable; independent reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§3.1–3.2, 4.3–4.4, 6/M1, 7
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Generalize finite target declaration beyond Novice without conflating four authorities.

**Scope:** Versioned JSON/Schema and typed actor/player/NPC/monster contracts, arbitrary visual body/job families, runtime profile and target revisions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Inventory, frozen runtime profile, operator target and exact artwork ledger remain separate records; edits never rewrite original inventory.
- [ ] Targets express required/optional/excluded actions, views, per-view counts, scope/full profile and compatibility; gameplay job identity is separate from visual body/sex/costume and attachment compatibility.
- [ ] Unfamiliar non-Novice resources import/inventory without code changes; player/NPC/monster semantic differences survive and unknown group/action mappings stay UNVERIFIED.
- [ ] Custom IDs are allowed offline but remain unmapped/unsupported until separately verified runtime support; stable IDs and version boundaries support later migrations.

## Verification

Schema validation and imported/new-target fixtures; unknown semantics and scoped/full-contract regressions.

Actual evidence: docs/evidence/rsf7/VERIFICATION.md; Python 3.14.4; 92 public, 12 private, 11 Rust-oracle synthetic, 9 native-harness unit tests PASS; 3 private oracle pairs AGREEMENT. Schema validator: 3 schemas, 12 valid and 36 invalid shape cases. Offline installed distribution PASS (92 tests, repeated wheel identity). Python 3.12/3.13 NOT_RUN: unavailable. No new native playback run claimed.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-4 (M0-04; task ID iemlbfn503r9pvc50xd8vbnd); RSF-5 (M0-05; task ID dpexmlk6wggb1xri9yefzjnq)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** M0-N is conditional, not an unconditional blocker: see M0-06 partial-state rule; operator must authorize structural execution. No M7 compatibility claims.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

- Commands, exit 0 results, artifact and canonical hashes: docs/evidence/rsf7/VERIFICATION.md; contract-identities.json; private-parity.json.
- M0-S PASS, M0-I PASS, M0-N PASS; operator acceptance recorded on RSF-6, now Accepted; M0_VERIFIED. Contract assessments keep artwork UNASSIGNED and native/visual/runtime compatibility evidence separate. No private assets distributed.
